kms-modal-tip1: Use the user-selected key to derive the DEK
kms-modal-tip3: The default key is Jiuwen. This instance is free of charge, and you can use it for 20,000 times per month for free. The decryption can be cached, but if there is a large amount of sensitive data, the number of decryption times may exceed 20,000.
kms-modal-tip4: Custom key creation and usage are charged
kms-modal-tip5: Free. Jiuwen generates a tenant master key for each tenant to derive a DEK. The tenant master key can be rotated, which is different from the customer master key (CMK) in KMS.
